runner.language_label: Go (modules, GNU make) Git large-file CLI
runner.install_command:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git make gettext fish zsh clang
(
  cd /tmp
  curl -fsSLO https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.5.linux-amd64.tar.gz
  echo "5c2c3b16caefa1d968a94c1daca04a7ca301a496d9b086e17ad77bb81393f053  go1.26.5.linux-amd64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
  rm -rf /usr/local/go
  tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.26.5.linux-amd64.tar.gz
  rm -f /tmp/go1.26.5.linux-amd64.tar.gz
)
mkdir -p /opt/go/pkg/mod /opt/go/cache /etc/go
chmod 1777 /opt/go /opt/go/pkg /opt/go/pkg/mod /opt/go/cache
rm -f /usr/local/bin/go /usr/local/bin/gofmt
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'export GOPATH="${GOPATH:-/opt/go}"' 'export GOMODCACHE="${GOMODCACHE:-/opt/go/pkg/mod}"' 'export GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-/opt/go/cache}"' 'export GOTOOLCHAIN="${GOTOOLCHAIN:-local}"' 'export GOPROXY="${GOPROXY:-https://proxy.golang.org,direct}"' 'export GOSUMDB="${GOSUMDB:-sum.golang.org}"' 'exec /usr/local/go/bin/go "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/go
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'exec /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/gofmt
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/go /usr/local/bin/gofmt
printf '%s\n' 'export PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH' 'export GOTOOLCHAIN=local' 'export GOPATH=/opt/go' 'export GOMODCACHE=/opt/go/pkg/mod' 'export GOCACHE=/opt/go/cache' 'export GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org,direct' 'export GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org' > /etc/profile.d/go.sh
printf '%s\n' 'GOPATH=/opt/go' 'GOMODCACHE=/opt/go/pkg/mod' 'GOCACHE=/opt/go/cache' 'GOTOOLCHAIN=local' 'GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org,direct' 'GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org' > /etc/go/env
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

init_metadata.tech_stack: Go CLI Git extension for pointer-based large-object clean/smudge and remote transfer (GNU make + go test; shell prove integration under t/)
